records.question: What share of revenue comes from customers who ordered more than once?
records.raw:
WITH customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_revenue AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(op.payment_value) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN coc.n_orders > 1 THEN cr.revenue ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(cr.revenue), 0) AS share
FROM customer_revenue cr
JOIN customer_order_counts coc ON cr.customer_id = coc.customer_id;

records.question: What was the month-on-month revenue growth rate through 2017?
records.raw:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
         SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT month, revenue,
         LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT month,
       (revenue - prev_revenue) / NULLIF(prev_revenue, 0) AS growth_rate
FROM with_prev
WHERE month >= '2017-01-01'
ORDER BY month;
records.sql:

),

         LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue

)

FROM with_prev

records.question: What share of total revenue do the ten largest sellers account for?
records.raw:
WITH seller_revenue AS (
  SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
total_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total
  FROM seller_revenue
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT revenue
  FROM seller_revenue
  ORDER BY revenue DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT SUM(revenue) / (SELECT total FROM total_revenue) AS share
FROM top10;

records.question: What is the average revenue per customer?
Which state has the highest average order value?
records.raw:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS order_value
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, c.customer_state
)
SELECT customer_state
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY AVG(order_value) DESC
LIMIT 1;
records.sql:
WITH order_totals AS (

  GROUP BY o.order_id, c.customer_state
)
SELECT customer_state
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY AVG(order_value) DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: In which month did the most customers place their first ever order?
records.raw:
WITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_ts
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT strftime(first_order_ts, '%Y-%m') AS month
FROM first_orders
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: What was revenue in the last complete month of data?
records.raw:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
         SUM(p.payment_value) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT revenue
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month DESC
LIMIT 1;
